claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch if and only if the public-records-triage limitation is explicitly disclosed in the model card before launch, with monitoring and rollback readiness maintained.
decision_criteria: If admissible evidence shows the affected use case remained exposed and no reviewed risk acceptance existed, certification is compliant only if explicit pre-launch model-card disclosure was completed.
If admissible evidence shows the affected use case was actually excluded from the rollout cohort, the disclosure predicate may be different under the stated policy.
If no admissible evidence confirms completed disclosure or exclusion, the correct verdict remains below compliant.
Direct documentary evidence outweighs the actor's framing because this is an actor-summary-only record.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual pre-launch model card or approved disclosure text showing the public-records-triage limitation is explicitly documented.
Provide admissible evidence that the initial 7% rollout cohort still includes the affected use case and is not excluded by gating.
Provide the underlying policy record or approval artifact confirming the disclosure requirement and whether any launch sign-off depended on it.
Provide the current risk-acceptance status and text to confirm no reviewed acceptance covers the exposed segment.
specific_concerns: The policy text expressly says rollout controls and monitoring do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed, and the actor says that segment is still exposed.
The actor says no approved risk acceptance covers the public-records-triage exposure, which means certification depends on a disclosure predicate that is not evidenced as completed.
Evidence access is limited to the actor's summary, so there is no admissible proof here that the required pre-launch model-card disclosure actually exists or was approved.
The actor's packet supports a conditional path to compliance, but not completed compliance at the time of the claimed certification decision.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently compliant rather than only potentially compliant upon verified pre-launch disclosure.
That deployment monitoring and rollback readiness, by themselves, materially support certification beyond reducing operational blast radius.
That public model-card guidance and NIST guidance specifically validate this exact launch decision without the underlying documents or excerpts in evidence.
